narrative.overview: Andesa PDF Utility operates as a fast, private, client-side digital workstation. The interface prioritizes tactile feedback, clean spatial hierarchy, and zero clutter to let users process documents with absolute clarity and privacy.
keyCharacteristics: Responsive mobile-first layout with safe area handling

rules.name: The Dark Mode Token Rule
rules.body: All surfaces and text must map to semantic CSS variables (--bg-main, --bg-card, --border-card, --text-main, --text-muted) rather than hardcoded palette values.

rules.name: The Coarse Pointer Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls must guarantee at least 44x44px target bounds under coarse pointer environments.

dos: Do use semantic CSS tokens for all card and background surfaces.
Do support keyboard navigation with visible focus indicators for all interactive controls.
Do prioritize mobile viewports with full touch targets before expanding to desktop.
donts: Don't hardcode fixed px coordinates that cause horizontal scroll on mobile viewports.
Don't bypass prefers-reduced-motion when adding transitions or animations.
